---
title: smalldocs 0.5.6
subtitle: Fixes to the API reference, and a smaller package
date: 2026-11-11
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

This release fixes five problems in the API reference. The build of another project's docs showed them.

- A comment beside `*args` or `**kwargs` is now its description. The row of such a parameter shows no
  default, where it said "required" before. The comment beside `**kwargs` needs fastcore 2.0 or later.
- Under `from __future__ import annotations`, `-> None` needs no comment. `smalldocs api check` asked
  for one, but the page shows no row for a return of `None`.
- The page writes a default that is a set or a frozenset in sorted order. Before, the order of a set of
  strings changed with each build, so the page changed too.
- The page lists a method that has an alias in its class, such as `abandon = discard`, once. Before, it
  listed the method twice.
- A class whose metaclass hides its signature shows the parameters of its `__init__`, not
  `(*args, **kwargs)`.

A page changes only where it has one of these cases. The most common case is a row for `*args` or
`**kwargs`, which now has an empty Default column.

The source package on PyPI, the `.tar.gz` file, now leaves out the folders `.agents`, `.claude` and
`.gest`. The source package of 0.5.5 held the folder `.gest`, which has the task notes of an agent. The
wheel never held them.
